name: Behavioural research and data collection
description: This course explores both qualitative and quantitative including experimental research methodologies. It begins with the principles of scientific research. Then learners will be introduced to qualitative and quantitative research including experimental research and its methods. Learners will be exposed to the data collection and analysis approaches used for qualitative and quantitative research.
